en.title: The subjunctive
en.summary: The subjunctive expresses a wish, a demand or an unreal situation; in English it is rare and formal.

paragraphs: The subjunctive is a verb form used for things that are not facts: wishes, demands, suggestions and unreal conditions. English has lost most of its subjunctive forms, so it is rare and often formal, but it survives in a few patterns.

items: It is essential that she **arrive** on time.
If I **were** you, I would wait.

paragraphs: After verbs and adjectives of demand, suggestion and importance, the present subjunctive is the base form of the verb, for every person, with no -s and no will. It is more common in American English; British English often uses should or an ordinary verb.

blocks.html:
TriggerSubjunctiveAlternative
suggest thatI suggest that he go.that he should go / that he goes
insist thatShe insisted that he apologise.that he should apologise
essential thatIt is essential that she be present.that she should be present
demand, recommend, proposeThey demanded that he resign.that he should resign

paragraphs: In unreal conditions and wishes, were can replace was for all persons: If I were rich; I wish he were here. In everyday speech, was is also common for I, he, she and it, but were is preferred in careful writing and in the phrase If I were you.

If I were you, I'd go.I wish it were summer.
If she were here, she'd help.I wish he were taller.

Wrong: **I suggest that he goes.** (acceptable in British English, but formal writing prefers go or should go)
Wrong: **I wish I was rich.** (informal; formal writing prefers were)
Do not add will: **If I were you** (not: If I would be you).

ro.title: Conjunctivul
ro.summary: Conjunctivul exprimă o dorință, o intenție sau o posibilitate și se formează cu particula „să”.

paragraphs: Modul conjunctiv arată o acțiune dorită sau posibilă. În limba română, conjunctivul înlocuiește foarte des infinitivul. Îl folosim după verbe precum „a vrea”, „a putea” sau „a trebui”.

Conjunctivul se formează adăugând particula „să” în fața verbului. Față de indicativ, forma verbului se schimbă de obicei doar la persoana a treia. Pentru forma negativă, punem cuvântul „nu” între „să” și verb.
